now.title: Logan
now.text: Logan ditches the bullet-riddled limo at a junkyard and buys a used pickup truck.

proposed.text: In Oklahoma City, Logan abandons the bullet-riddled limo, handing its keys to strangers, and buys a used pickup truck.

changes.evidence: Logan: after the escape from the smelting plant leaves the limo riddled with bullets, Logan drives it to a hotel in Oklahoma City, abandons it by handing the keys to strangers, and buys a used Ram truck to continue to Eden. No junkyard is involved.

proposed.title: X-Men '97
proposed.text: In episode 1, Jean tracks Trask to a Sentinel junkyard in the Sahara, and the X-Men destroy his Master Mold and take him into custody.

changes.evidence: X-Men '97 episode 1 'To Me, My X-Men': Jean locates Trask at a junkyard in the Sahara, the X-Men destroy the Sentinels and a Master Mold there and apprehend Trask; the UN then holds him. The file jumps from his TAS appearances straight to his death in episode 7 with no record of this capture.
